      Recent activity

      Made a mistake? Undo an award or redemption. It writes a correction, never deletes.

      Settings

      Points are shared

      Items, visits and your staff PIN are still your own. Only the points are common.

      Your spot

      How your spot earns, and how it looks on the cards your customers carry. These save together: change as many as you like, then press Save settings at the end of this group.

      Earning rate

      Customers earn for a $10 purchase (before their tier multiplier).

      Exact amount entry Let staff type the exact purchase amount on the keypad.

      Quick amount buttons

      Tap-to-award buttons shown once you scan a customer's code. Each is a set purchase amount; points are that amount × your rate. They're optional: remove them all and the terminal shows just the keypad.

      Location

      Shown as a tappable map on your customers' cards, and tapping it opens directions in their maps app. Leave blank to hide the map.

      Only needed if you run more than one location on this login. It's what the store switcher at the top of this screen shows, so staff can tell your branches apart at a glance. Customers never see it.

      Logo

      Shown next to your name on customers' cards. Square images look best, since we shrink it to a small icon.

      Visits Show a rotating visit code on the VISITS tab. Customers scan it once a night to collect a visit, then spend visits on any item you have given a visit price.

      Set what each item costs in visits on the ITEMS tab. Turning this off hides visits from customers, it does not take away the ones they have collected.

      ● Unsaved changes, save before leaving this tab.

      Access

      Who can work this terminal. Each of these saves on its own button the moment you press it. Save settings above does not apply to them.

      Staff PIN

      The 4-digit code staff enter to reach Settings and redemptions. Changing it signs out every terminal, including this one, so everyone re-enters the new PIN next time.

      Login password

      Change the password for this terminal's email login. You'll stay signed in on this device, so use the new password next time you sign in.

      Sign out

      Signs this terminal out of . Staff will need the email and password to sign back in, so keep them handy.

      Downloads

      Scan-here QR poster

      Download this, print it, and put it up where customers can see it. They scan it with their phone camera to get the WeRewards app and start earning at your spot.

      Add item

      Set at least one. Leave a box empty and the item cannot be bought that way.

      Unsaved changes
